_comment: Single source of truth for crawler user-agent substrings. Matched case-insensitively as substrings so UA version bumps don't drop a bot. Used by the gated page-SSR handlers (server/crawlerUa.ts) and by scripts/seo-check.mjs. /blog/* intentionally has NO UA gate (SSR for all visitors) — do not add this list there. When adding a bot to robots.txt, add its UA substring here too.
